elder.about: the dialogue elder (노인, 합쇼체): the steady, warm, medium-low voice fits best of the pack voices; a dedicated older-man voice would be a new clone voice with its own seed and has not been rendered

librarian.about: the librarian (사서, 합쇼체) keeps one fixed voice whatever the villager's personality (PLAN 3.1): the calm teacher-like female2

trader.about: the wandering trader (떠돌이 상인, 해요체): fixed voice, the brighter young male2 (not the elder's male1, they can meet in one village)

golem.about: the iron golem as narrator (철 골렘): fixed voice, the steady male1; it never talks in the same conversation as the elder
